Message.Name: Order Book Clear Message
Message.Description: Generated when the order book is required to be cleared, for example after the transition between certain market states, or when an instrument's Trading State Condition is Trade Halt. Following an Order Book Clear, if an instrument is subsequently open for trading any resting orders are sent as Top Of Book, Aggregate Order Book or Order Add messages to allow clients to rebuild the order book. It is not published when an instrument enters or leaves Trade Pause.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time the trading state of the instrument changed, resulting in the Order Book Clear message.

Message.Name: Cross Request Message
Message.Description: Generated when a cross request is created on LMEselect.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect created this cross request.

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: The identifier of the Cross that is unique for the day. The specification types this field UInt64; the documented data types define Uint64 and the stated length of eight bytes agrees.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: The time this cross request will expire.
